Strand: Strand 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Observing and Articulating signs (Listening and Speaking) 6.1.1 Conversat ional skills: Negotiation skills, part of Strand 6 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Which words or expressions would one use when negotiating? 2. How can one enhance their negotiation skills?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Observing and Articulating signs (Listening and Speaking) 6.1.1 Conversat ional skills: Negotiation skills together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Problem solving: Learner open mindedly negotiates or requests for a favour during a hot seating activity

● Collaboration: Learner develop teamwork skill as he/she discusses using signs the use of verbal and non-verbal cues in

conversations

Values:
• Responsibility: is enhanced as the learner uses language appropriately to hold negotiations

• Unity: is developed as the learner works with peers to hold mock negotiations

Link to other subjects

Learner is able to relate conversational skills to their learning in all other subjects such as Kiswahili, Social Studies and Creative

Arts and Sports.
